figures.label: Fig. 1
figures.caption: Fig. 1. Block diagram of the synthesizer.

references.sentence: The synthesizer consists of a phase/frequency detector (PFD), charge pump (CP), loop filter (LPF), a VCO, and a multimode prescaler (see Fig. 1).
The chosen filter is a second-order passive network rather than an active filter in order to reduce noise and power dissipation (see Fig. 1).

The PFD controls the charge pump (see Fig. 1); when the UP signal is low, the charge pump sources a constant current into the loop filter, and when the DOWN signal is high, it sinks a constant current from the loop filter.
